title: Best honest Linux proxy for the Mac-blocked strict cascade: per-stage replay scoreboard from committed artifacts
environment: Linux Ubuntu, Node 20.18.1, pnpm 10.15.1, ffmpeg 4.4.2, LINUX-CPU (no Apple Vision, no Mac, no iPhone)
mission: e06 proved canonical strict-cascade replay is Mac-blocked. Replay every cascade stage that IS runnable on Linux from committed artifacts on the integrated branch and produce a per-stage Linux-proxy scoreboard, explicitly NOT-CANONICAL/NOT-MAC, as the regression baseline for future waves.

stagesReplayed.OWNERSHIP: ownershipBench.ts ± --apply-corrections — corrected 39 dual frames / 18 pose, incumbent pose-subset 13/18 = 0.722 (matches e05 after)
stagesReplayed.BALL: ballHardSliceEval.ts — 43 D2-06 labels: OBSERVED 4/35 hits, 2/2 OCCLUDED abstention violations (matches e12 after)
stagesReplayed.CONTACT: e02 contactGoldReplay via assertion-free wrapper — 7/10 estimated, 1 wrong marker, median 27ms (DRIFT vs e02: 6/10, 0 wrong, median 17ms)
stagesReplayed.STROKE: strokeHeuristicBench.ts via persisting wrapper — L1 9/0/8, conf-wrong 3 on 18/29 evaluable gold (matches e03 heuristic-4)

stagesProvenNotRunnable.TARGET: ta-bench replay needs datasets/corpus/runs/<recId>/people.json (gitignored, absent) — probe at head replayed 0/301 committed cases
stagesProvenNotRunnable.PADDLE: needs datasets/paddle-bench/runs/ (gitignored, Mac-only per e06 forensics); no committed paddle tracks exist

keyFinding.measured: wavea-sasebo-volleys target contact @52019: e02 committed state errorMs 16 @ conf 0.70, ballConfirmed=true → head errorMs 144 @ conf 0.79, ballConfirmed=false. pnpm --filter @pickle/vision-geometry eval FAILS at integration head ('expected 144 to be less than or equal to 132').
keyFinding.provenance: replay harness and gold unchanged since e02 (empty git log f2dedf7..HEAD on contactGoldReplay.ts; same 10 gold target events). Only estimateContact source change in range: e09 f3a0e63 (gap-edge censoring + paddle reach tether), merged after e02's artifact. e09 was validated on synthetic fixtures only. Root-cause attribution to the censoring path is stated as inference in the scoreboard, not as proven fact.
keyFinding.handoff: integrator decision needed: re-tune 4.2 censoring on committed gold or version-split to 4.3; note e02 and e09 both shipped as 'contact-evidence-4.2' (version collision).

honestyNotes: Every artifact is labeled NOT-CANONICAL / NOT-MAC with per-stage coverage limits; no comparison against the Mac north-star table is valid.
Cross-stage strict-survival conditioning is NOT measured: stages are replayed independently on committed inputs, unlike the canonical waterfall.
Held-out cases wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 were never read; the fresh-candidate pool was untouched.
No production code, integrator-owned docs, migrations, or runs/ directories were modified; wrappers reuse existing harness code unmodified.

The e02 artifact datasets/experiments/wave-e/e02-contact-gold-replay-metrics.json was NOT rewritten: the failing eval aborts before its write, and a byte-diff against a pre-run backup confirmed it is unchanged.
A probe TA-bench run at head produced an n=0 result file which was deleted, not committed (0 cases replayable — recorded above as the TARGET coverage proof).
